[Image: Front of a building with a car parked outside]

The car is 3.5 m long. About how long is the building?
figure_description: A line drawing showing the front facade of a single-story building. In the center is a double door with an arched window above it. Symmetrically flanking the doors are six identical rectangular windows with multipaned sashes: three windows to the left of the door and three to the right. Parked on the ground along the far left of the building facade is a black car, positioned spanning the space of roughly the first two windows. The length of the entire building is approximately four times the length of the car.
